fields.Player Concept (as known): Plasmoid Sorcerer; excels at spelljamming; carries part of a ship within himself
fields.Personal Thread: A drifting plasmoid with no family or lasting home, now carrying an incomplete model spelljamming ship that formed inside him for reasons he cannot explain.
fields.Current State: Back in the cargo hold as the crew's medic after reaching the Command Deck, where his magic failed him.
fields.What They Last Learned: That the ship's dead master is a beholder whose central eye still cancels magic on the Command Deck.
fields.Notable Items: Light hammer, shield, incomplete model spelljamming ship
fields.Overview (Player): Boogie is a plasmoid cadet at Caelestis in a semi-transparent blue form with a glittering stone inside him and an inner rhythm that pulls him into dance. He instinctively helps and repairs rather than commands, and has taken the crew's medical role rather than the helm. The incomplete model ship that formed inside him matches one stolen from an instructor, and his sleep has begun to fill with visions of other versions of himself and a presence converging on him.

bullets: Rushed to help wounded Tumak during the Moonraider simulation rather than seek glory
Held a contested corner bunk calmly when Veena tried to take it, with Sol backing him
Charmed a light hammer from Mr. Blip, thinking about repair over command
Took instantly to the Nexus helm exercise and declared he wants to keep the ship alive, not take the helm
Endured the gym assault course and used magic to help Gregory up the final climb
Shared his lonely drifting past with Tumak and promised the crew would help find Tumak's family
Helped Mirt in his hangover before reacting to the room
Pulled a tiny, half-missing model spelljamming ship from his own chest
Ordered only fruit and was given a silvery starfruit at the Weeping Goddess
Set his half-missing model ship on the table for the crew to see, though no one took up the meaning
Spoke for the medical role and quietly insisted Gregory take the helm
Heard Saerthe describe his own stolen miniature ship — the same model as the one within Boogie — and said nothing
Tended the bulwark through the storm and collected the salvage logbook into his own chest
Leapt onto the githyanki ship, realized he was overmatched, and threw himself back to the hammerhead
Helped pull members of the rival crew upright in the wreckage of the simulation chamber
Understood the recovered rod for what it was — a device built to feed on ambient magic and detonate — before catching the word 'Vocath' spoken between Saerthe and Tarto
Told Mirt of the tribal sacrifice he survived as a child and the sense of being watched ever since
Dreamed of countless other versions of himself in an infinite dark, a presence converging on him, and woke with his form half-dissolved before humming himself back together
Checked his chest and found the half-ship and the derelict logbook both still there
Understood, alongside Gregory, that Ostekk-6's damage was mechanical and beyond anything magic could mend
Gave the legless Ostekk-6 a pair of legs, a small, wrongly built replica of himself that carried him at the waist
Spread his own gel over the crew and laid a slowing charm on them so they drifted down the shaft
Blessed Casey, Tumak and Bartholomew as the behir woke, and steadied Casey's strike
Filled Ostekk-6's legs with a leaping charm and launched him across the Hollow Deck at the behir
Called the retreat when three clockwork horrors answered the behir's screech
Missed the rope and fell down the shaft, calling on his faith to burn a gap through the flowers below him
Found the plane where the ship's gravity turns over, pulled himself through, and called the others down
Recognized the body on the Command Deck as a beholder whose central eye still cancels magic

fields.Player Concept (as known): Hadozee Warlock; zodiac-flavored magic; reads the sky
fields.Personal Thread: Following a vision and a voice that told him 'Go there' — a path toward a place beyond H’catha in the Viren star system.
fields.Current State: Back in the cargo hold as the crew's bosun after the descent to the Command Deck.
fields.What They Last Learned: That the behir was coiled around something giving off a soft light, and that the Command Deck's wisps can be struck once they latch on.
fields.Notable Items: Star-etched constellation shirt (stolen from Mirt's wardrobe)
fields.Overview (Player): Casey is a hadozee warlock cadet at Caelestis, barefoot and composed beneath a pale green cloak stitched with constellations, wielding cold star-bright magic. Awkward and half-orbiting any conversation, he serves as the crew's bosun. A vision beyond Mirt's wardrobe pointed him toward the Viren star system, and a familiar presence has begun following him elsewhere.

bullets: Fought with speed and cold, star-bright magic aboard the Moonraider simulation
Crossed the gym assault course with natural ease
Slipped secretly into Mirt's wardrobe and saw unfamiliar constellations and a flickering point
Heard a familiar voice tell him 'Go there'
Stole a shirt from the wardrobe and etched the constellation pattern he saw
Passed the stolen shirt to Tumak's hidden bunk corner without explanation
Pulled a Sea Dock cargo notice from the refectory board without explaining why
Drew Ryeback's private life out of him with warmth and earned an extra portion
Followed Tumak to the bathroom unseen and noticed his jacket askew, saying nothing
Took the bosun's role for the crew
Worked a cargo shift at Rindle Gearloft's dock by mistake and was paid for the time
Sat at the Sky Dock thinking of his brother, and felt the familiar presence settle beside him again
Duplicated the salvage logbook to confound the githyanki and fired across the gap in the fight
Pulled members of the rival crew upright in the wreckage of the simulation chamber
Went first into the tyrant ship wrapped in a shell of cold arcane ice, and did not move quietly
Glimpsed a two-starred constellation shape rising in Bartholomew when he looked closely
Held the line beside Sol against the clockwork horrors, working his aim from cover
Cast Arms of Hadar rendered through his constellations, tentacles of starlight filling the shaft
Climbed the crew down toward the deck below by rope
Split into copies of himself and cut into the behir from the walls
Saw that the behir had been coiled around something giving off a soft light
Glided down the shaft and flipped through the gravity plane without the rope
Was latched onto and drained by wisps on the Command Deck, and learned to slap them off

fields.Player Concept (as known): Autognome; navigation-minded; senses direction and anomalies
fields.Personal Thread: Farther from home and his master than ever, feeling a new tug in his core drawing him somewhere unknown.
fields.Current State: Back in the cargo hold as the crew's navigator, the pull in his chest pointing toward the Command Deck.
fields.What They Last Learned: That the pull in his chest grows stronger near the dead beholder on the Command Deck.
fields.Overview (Player): Gregory is a bronze autognome cadet at Caelestis with glasses and a mustache, hesitant and observant, quick to notice what others miss. He has settled as the crew's navigator, his course-plotting proven under pressure. Far from his dead master, he feels a pull in his core drawing him toward somewhere he cannot yet name, and has begun to reach for others before the damage does.

bullets: Used clever spellwork to spoil a deadly strike during the Moonraider simulation
Recalled the code of conduct forbidding gifts and unofficial payments at the sky dock
Unsettled by Mr. Blip, an autognome who looked unnervingly like him
Overcame thinking too far ahead in the Nexus helm exercise once Saerthe named the problem
Saw through the gym's first illusion and called the truth to Sol
Added frightened but effective magic in the fight in Mirt's quarters
Accepted a set of spare utensils from Ryeback, taking the kindly-meant gesture as it was offered
Took the navigator's role and joined the second helm exercise at the Nexus
Plotted the hammerhead's course toward the asteroid field and named targets in the githyanki fight
Saw the arc of black lightning snap out of Sol and back again during the asteroid crossing
Duplicated the salvage logbook alongside Casey to confound the enemy
Judged, straight-faced, that no cadet-manual provision governed stopping for stranded vessels
Spotted the arcane rod jammed in the wall, worked it free, and stepped clear as energy arced off it
Assessed the rod with precision as spent arcane dynamite, unlikely to detonate again absent another strong magic source, then thrust it at Boatswain Tarto and fled
Sorted through Saerthe's chaotic desk and found a note about Bartholomew's helm affinity
Searched the Nexus terminals for arcane artillery and runes, but was locked out of a fleet-clearance category by his cadet star
Told Mirt of his master and creator, Gregory Prime, now dead and buried
Read his master's journal that night, dwelling on the line about getting underneath things before the break did
Saw his own face on the broken autognome the clockwork horrors were feeding on, and cast before he had fully decided to
Opened the tyrant-ship fight with a volley of magic missiles across the clockwork horrors
Pulled the broken autognome Ostekk-6 clear of danger with a Vortex Warp before turning back to fight — a mercy the table felt
Understood, with Boogie, that Ostekk-6's ruin was mechanical and no magic could close it
Shared the telepathic link Tumak opened, receiving Ostekk-6's warnings, and sent magic missiles into the wisp swarm
Found the remains of Ostekk-8 and Ostekk-4 among the Hollow Deck's wreckage
Followed a pull in his chest to Ostekk-2 and woke it with a jolt of lightning
Fought the behir with lightning and with twin jets of water from cannons in his own chest
Climbed down after Boogie and carried the rope through the gravity plane
Felt the pull in his chest again on the Command Deck, stronger, pointing at the beholder's body

fields.Player Concept (as known): Astral Elf Paladin of Beshaba; resilient and resourceful
fields.Personal Thread: A paladin of Beshaba whose luck turns unlucky, now having heard the goddess herself laugh at his shoulder.
fields.Current State: Guarding the helm in the tyrant ship's cargo hold as the crew's gunner while the others scouted below.
fields.What They Last Learned: That academy shipments route through Mr. Blip toward Toril and H’catha, and that a voice takes interest in his fate, doubting he has escaped where he came from.
fields.Notable Items: Heavier armament acquired from the quartermaster's stores
fields.Overview (Player): Sol Fortuna is a tall, pale, dark-haired astral elf paladin of Beshaba with white eyes, steady even after simulated death. He anticipates danger before it arrives and puts himself between it and his crew as their gunner and front line. Beshaba has laughed at his shoulder, and now a curious voice speaks to him of fate and whether he has truly escaped his origin.

bullets: Drove a ballista bolt through an attacker during the Moonraider simulation
Stepped silently behind Boogie in the bunk dispute to back him without being asked
Sought out Joffrey and asked what this life truly offered; talked his way into heavier armament
Navigated the Nexus helm exercise by anticipating danger before it arrived
Fell hard on the gym course but forced himself back up to finish after Boogie shouted him on
Noticed the wardrobe in Mirt's chambers opened onto bounded astral night
Subdued the final centipede creature alive, sensing it might matter as evidence
Told Boogie his life had always turned unlucky and he wanted to spend it exploring
Asked Ryeback for soup and was given knock-your-mama's-socks-off soup
Took the guns for the crew
Sensed misfortune reaching for a crewmate mid-jump and took it onto himself instead, saving Boogie's landing
Heard a woman laugh three times as his strength dropped and understood it was Beshaba
Traced the crate at the Sky Dock with Boogie, finding it marked with the same symbol as the rod
Worked an elven cargo clerk in conversation and learned shipments route through Mr. Blip, with Toril and H’catha as destinations
Heard a curious, unhurried voice in the night ask why he embraced chaos and whether he had truly escaped where he came from, and answered honestly
Took the front of both tyrant-ship fights and held the line, drawing the enemy onto himself
Cast Divine Sense across the wisp bloom and struck the first flower with Sacred Flame
Cast Arms of Hadar into the wisp swarm, dark tentacles catching the weak-limbed things
Used Misfortune's Favor to draw ill luck onto his own shoulders and made the save through it
Stayed above in the cargo hold with Ryeback, Pffred and Krik'Lit to guard the helm and the crew

fields.Player Concept (as known): Rogue (Soulknife); searching for somewhere they cannot yet name
fields.Personal Thread: Searching for his own family, now trusting the crew to help him find them.
fields.Current State: Back in the cargo hold as the crew's captain, knowing where the helm must go.
fields.What They Last Learned: That the helm belongs on the platform beneath the dead beholder at the heart of the Command Deck.
fields.Notable Items: Crimson bag of holding and valuables (from Mirt's wardrobe), hidden star-etched shirt, soul knife
fields.Overview (Player): Tumak Swan is a slight rogue swallowed by an oversized coat, muttering reassurances to himself, whose mind often seems divided. He holds the captain's chair for the crew and keeps a curtained corner of his bunk for things he would rather not explain. He is searching for a family he cannot yet name — and has begun to manifest powers and glowing half-runes he does not understand, with a tether now pulling him toward home.

bullets: Answered the Moonraider chaos with a crossbow shot, then took a brutal blast to the shoulder
Traded for a darker bunk more to his liking
Bought a healing potion at the quartermaster's stores
Managed the Nexus helm exercise, though Saerthe noticed part of his mind seemed elsewhere
Followed Casey into the wardrobe and claimed a crimson bag of holding and valuables
Admitted to Boogie he is searching for his own family
Hung curtains around his bunk and hid Casey's stolen shirt without question
Studied the refectory notice board for anything familiar from home and found nothing
Ordered two meatloafs from Ryeback
Warned the table that things going missing all over the academy might mean something, then said no more
Took the captain's chair for the crew, calling movement during the salvage run
Fired a rope line across the void to try to catch Boogie, missing by half a body's length
Searched Saerthe's desk at the Nexus and looked for symbols on the terminals, finding nothing useful
Found a dim blue half-rune glowing on the sole of his left foot and a second, different mark on his right shoulder — two halves of two separate wholes
Told Mirt of Joffrey's suspicious exchange at the Sky Dock, and of the family and destination he is trying to find
Glimpsed 'fleet intelligence archive' written on Mirt's notepad, the same phrase from the locked Nexus terminal
Argued Mirt into granting the crew sailor-level clearance
Grew frustrated with Ostekk-6's silence and opened a telepathic link between himself, Gregory, and Ostekk-6 in a moment of need, without understanding how
Cast a fire bolt for the first time, magic he did not know he had
Summoned his soul knife for the first time as his two runes flared, drawn through a small portal, and felt for the first time a tether running toward home
Heard the Runekeeper say all things find their way home as his throw went wide, and the blade curved true to strike the last wisp
Called up his soul knives for the second time in his life and drove one into the behir
Threw up a shield of force that the behir's bite could not get through
Poured his potion into Bartholomew after the behir dropped him
Saw the near-invisible wisps on the Command Deck gathering on Casey and Bartholomew
Worked out that the dead beholder lay on the helm's platform, and that the helm belongs there
Told Miken the crew had defeated the beholder

links.name: Tumak's Runes and the Tether Home

fields.Player Concept (as known): Human; Druid; Wilder; newly arrived cadet with a natural helm affinity
fields.Personal Thread: A newly arrived wilder cadet finding his place aboard a crew, with an uncanny natural gift for the helm.
fields.Current State: Back in the cargo hold as the crew's spelljammer, recovering after nearly dying in the behir's jaws.
fields.What They Last Learned: That magic fails on the Command Deck, and that the wisps there drain whoever they latch onto.
fields.Overview (Player): Bartholomew is a human druid and wilder, a cadet at Caelestis with an uncanny natural affinity for the helm. Quiet and untroubled, he has slipped into the crew and settled as its spelljammer. When he shifts into a starry form, a two-starred constellation surfaces — a shape he carries from a fall he took as a child.

bullets: Oriented by Boatswain Tarto, who told him being a wilder changed nothing once he was aboard a crew
Found a seat at the Weeping Goddess beside Miken and joined the gathering crew
Ordered the dragon scale pizza Tarto had recommended
Took instantly to the helm in a Nexus practice, settling the open spelljammer's seat for the crew
Flew the hammerhead through an electrical storm and led the salvage race
Called a fog cloud over the hull and, during the githyanki attack, slowed the ship to give Boogie a way back aboard
Pulled members of the rival crew upright in the wreckage of the simulation chamber
Shifted into a starry form of light bearing two stars, and recognized it as the shape he saw during a childhood fall
Dropped a lit match down the bottomless quarters shaft and watched wisps rise toward the light
Cast into the wisp fight in the choked shafts and took a full shock for ten damage
Lit his staff to light the shaft for the descent
Loosed frost at the behir, then soaked it with a jet of water that scattered the lightning in its mouth
Went down in the behir's jaws and was brought back by Tumak's potion
Threw back a clockwork horror with a wave of thunder during the retreat
Found his magic would not answer on the Command Deck and drank a potion instead
Touched a wisp and was latched onto and drained, and learned to slap them off
